children: PDS Biotechnology announced a private placement expected to raise approximately $11.55 million at the initial closing, with an additional $11 million milestone tranche committed by Nant and AB Group upon FDA submission of a Phase 3 protocol for PDS0301. The PIPE features common shares or pre-funded warrants paired with one-year $0.22 common warrants, with unit pricing of $0.2825 (shares) or $0.28217 (pre-funded). The company also signed a Registration Rights Agreement to facilitate investor resale and intends to grant NantWorks a one-year exclusive option to negotiate an exclusive license for PDS0101. Proceeds will be used to repay debt and for working capital and development programs.
